text:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — prepping a CSM scorecard demo for BeaconHealth next Wed (11:00 PT). Need final uptime / P95 latency numbers and the credit calc runbook to walk them through cause->credit mapping.
Tom Reeves: On it. Dashboard link: https://redwood.app/dash/BeaconHealth/scorecard — I'll export last 90d uptime + latency percentiles by route. ETA EOD today.
Morgan Lee: FYI the new prefix-KV cache rollout changed P95 on embeddings routes. I'll add a note to the ledger about pipeline version v2.3.2.
Jae Park: Can you confirm which routes we should present? Suggest `generation`, `embeddings`, `rerank`. generation has 98.7% uptime last 30d.
Tom Reeves: Agree — will include per-route rows. Also will attach the raw CSV.
SLA Bot: export complete — /exports/1799999999-beacon-scorecard-90d.csv (sha256: abc123def456...)
Aisha Patel: Nina — can you confirm contract cap for credits? Need exact wording to avoid surprises during demo.
Nina Gomez (Legal): Section 4.2 limits credits to the monthly service fees up to 100% of one invoice period, with aggregation not to exceed credits equivalent to 3 months across consecutive incidents. I'll paste the clause in the shared doc.
Morgan Lee: For the demo, recommend showing the credit calculator: input outage minutes -> shows prorated credit and SLA breach window. I can mock a quick spreadsheet.
Tom Reeves: I'll attach the latency-ledger CSV + a small script to compute credits.
Tom Reeves: ```bash
python tools/credit_calc.py --ledger /exports/1799999999-beacon-scorecard-90d.csv --output /exports/credits-preview.csv
```
Aisha Patel: Perfect. Deliverables: 1) scorecard PDF, 2) credits-preview CSV, 3) one-pager for customers explaining credit triggers. Who wants the action items?
Morgan Lee: I'll do the one-pager (draft by tomorrow).
Tom Reeves: I'll generate the PDF + CSV (EOD).
Nina Gomez (Legal): I'll review the one-pager for language (tomorrow morning).
Aisha Patel: Thanks team :thumbsup: — will run a 20m dry-run Tue 10am PT. Calendar invite incoming.
